# PTO Policy

> SAMPLE CONTENT for development and evals. Not a real company policy.

## Allotment

Full-time employees receive 15 vacation days each calendar year. Part-time employees accrue vacation in proportion to their scheduled hours.

## Accrual by tenure

| Years of service | Vacation days per year |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | 15 |
| 3 to 5 | 20 |
| 6 or more | 25 |

## Requesting time off

Submit vacation requests in the timekeeping system at least five business days before the first day of leave. Managers approve or decline requests within two business days.

## Carryover

Up to five unused vacation days may carry over into the next calendar year. Days above that limit are forfeited on December 31.
